answer: The oasis graph is validated at intake and the mesa frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and pulse anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 1223 fake identities need 713 separate proofs, each held 51 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
